title: TrustStore accepts a no-op same-key rotation as a new key generation
description: CORRECTNESS: TrustStore._rotate_key validates the signed transcript and destination collision only when new_iid differs, but never requires new_pubkey != old_pubkey. A caller can sign a rotation from a key to itself, receive success, advance the persisted rotation sequence, and replace the entry/timestamps even though spec 06 defines this as a key change that accepts a new key. Downstream rotation consumers may also treat success as authority to create fresh replay state. Align with the link rotation invariant by rejecting identical old/new keys before mutation; cover durable and semantic APIs.
